author: Spoookeh
body:
Hey there,

So I was recently temporarily banned (being 2 minutes ago) for void-logging. Although this infraction only lasts for an hour I would still like to appeal it seen as it does look very bad on my profile.

Username- SpookehSkeletons

Reason for temp-ban - Void Logging

Reasons why I should be unbanned - I would like this infraction to be appealed because of some different reasons

I do admit that I void logged but it was under the circumstances that no one shot me off or knocked me off but I just simply walked off. At the time, I was a little bit annoyed and kind of stressed with IRL stuff. As you could imagine, this made me a little bit more annoyed. Because I simply walked off the edge of the map, I was not denying anyone any credits by void logging and therefore not affecting anyone. It only occurred once and the next time I walked off the edge I didn't void log.


I do hope that I get this infraction appealed and I am extremely sorry for my actions, thank you.

title: Appealing my temp-ban

replies.author: GrapeSmoothie
replies.body:
Hello Spooks,

Even though you void logging didn't affect anyone, it is still against the rules and avoiding a death so you have received a valid punishment for it as stated under section B.8 on the rules page.

Your appeal has been denied

Regards,
GrapeSmoothie, Senior Moderator
